description: This Java class implements a security filter for JWT authentication in a Spring Boot application. It intercepts incoming HTTP requests, extracts JWT tokens from the Authorization header, validates and parses the token, and sets the security context with user details and roles if valid.

classes.name: JwtAuthFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that intercepts HTTP requests to perform JWT-based authentication, extending Spring's OncePerRequestFilter for a one-time request filtering.

classes.name: Principal
classes.description: A record class representing authenticated user's principal details, specifically userId and email.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overridden method that performs the core filtering logic: extracting JWT, validating, parsing it, creating authentication token if valid, and setting security context.
